definition.write: one write-enabled observe pass on sentence 0 produces the fast memory
definition.dose: the same written fast is multiplied by k in {0, 1, 10, 100, 1000}
definition.reading: from each scaled state, sentence 1 is scored and compared to the k = 0 baseline
definition.monotone: the max |delta| values are non-decreasing in k
definition.practical: at least one k reaches max |delta| > 1e-3
definition.closed_state: the nine legacy readings on the main subject stay equal before and after

criteria.write: the written fast has abs sum > 0
criteria.curve: all five doses are reported with max |delta| and mean |delta|
criteria.monotone: max |delta| is non-decreasing across the five doses
criteria.practical: the first dose above 1e-3 is reported; absence is a finding, not a failure
criteria.saturation: the delta(1000)/delta(100) ratio is reported and classified
criteria.closed_state: the nine legacy readings stay equal and the main parameter digest does not move
criteria.rerun: the R39 anchor carries a commit, a runner blob sha1, a runner sha256 and a core sha256

sentences: 让圆口的器皿到四方木台。
让圆口的器皿到靠窗的台面。
